method.samples: One separate warmup per revision/workload, then 3 paired samples alternating order; no simultaneous builds or benchmarks.
method.heap: Allocator requested bytes, incremental live/peak. Source prepared before context/pipeline/lookup windows; file read inside discovery/CLI windows. Runtime initialized before windows. Instrumented allocator probe, not pristine executable.
method.time: Probe Instant measured interval; ordinary CLI process elapsed from separate uninstrumented release binaries. Wrapper process RSS is RUSAGE_CHILDREN in bytes (macOS), not heap or aggregate process-tree peak.
method.limits: 25 s per child, 30 s per wrapper; fixed 1 candidate, max1, jobs1; /usr/bin/true executor. Source fixtures at most 2 MiB.
method.payload: Logical payload unchanged; exact-limit tests independently verify 395 success/394 failure. Heap is not payload or workspace disk charges.
method.baseline: Original 34e3349099ce7fd61838629ee8c0d0b814e65a5d frozen release. Candidate includes Tasks1 and2; no selected line ranges and one tiny workspace file minimize unrelated effects, not an isolated causal timing guarantee.
